verdict.rationale: Turso documents a full Platform API for programmatically creating/tearing down databases, groups, orgs, and tokens (turso-docs-8, turso-docs-60), plus SDK-level push/pull, branching, and PITR that mirror CLI/UI actions (turso-docs-7, turso-docs-18, turso-docs-33). However, there's no explicit statement or evidence of full UI/API parity, and a probe for a formal API spec (OpenAPI) returned 404s across candidate paths, suggesting the API surface isn't exhaustively self-documented in a structured way. missing for 10: explicit parity confirmation between dashboard UI and API, a discoverable OpenAPI/schema spec, and independent verification that every UI action (e.g. billing, dashboard-only settings) has an API equivalent.
